name: Sorenson
desc:
Videophone Customer Care Agent, Tier 1 (Remote) | $13.46 - $22.40/hr | ASL Required, Videophone/Chat/Email, No Voice Calls

Company: Sorenson Communications
Industry: Language Services | Video Relay and Deaf Communication Technology
What Your Day Will Look Like:
This is a great fit for a Deaf or hard of hearing participant who is fluent in ASL. You'll take calls by videophone (signing, not talking) from Sorenson customers and staff across the country. You'll help with account questions, new product setup, troubleshooting, and teaching customers how to use Sorenson products and services. You'll also handle issues that come in by email and live chat.
There is some sales in it, since the posting says you'll promote company products, features, and services, but it's mostly support and training.
This job is open to people in all states except Alaska, Arizona, California, Colorado, Hawaii, Nevada, New Mexico, New York (except Rochester), and Washington. Oklahoma is OK.

Posted: November 9, 2026 | Requisition #: VIDEO010289 | Full-Time
skills:
Actual Minimum Requirements
Education Minimum: High school diploma or better.
 Required Experience: 1 year of customer service or equivalent experience.
 Preferred Experience: Not listed.
 Required Skills:
Must be fluent in American Sign Language (ASL)
Type 45+ wpm
Basic computer skills in Windows
Able to write simple emails and correspondence
Able to manage cases and time, detail oriented, good at multitasking
Able to work on your own with little supervision
Able to sign for long periods of time
Able to lift and move equipment 30-50 lbs
Best Fit
This role is ideal for:
Deaf or hard of hearing participants who are fluent in ASL and want to work from home
Someone with at least a year of customer service, retail, or food service experience
Someone who is comfortable with technology and can walk others through it
Not a Good Fit for:
Anyone who is not fluent in ASL
Someone who needs a set daytime schedule (must be flexible for nights, weekends, and holidays)
Anyone without wired internet (Ethernet is required)
notes:
Expected Application & Interviewing Process:
Apply on Sorenson's job board (link above). Main careers page: www.sorenson.com/company/careers/
Interview process not spelled out in the posting. Expect an application, a recruiter screen, and an interview, likely done in ASL by video.
WRO can provide an interpreter for interviews and training if needed.

Top 10 Resume Keywords:
American Sign Language (ASL)
Customer support
Troubleshooting
Account management
Customer training
Videophone
Live chat and email support
Case management
Typing 45+ wpm
Customer satisfaction

4-5 interview questions for this role:
Tell me about a time you helped a customer fix a problem with a device or app.
How would you explain a new product to a customer who isn't comfortable with technology?
How do you stay organized when you're juggling several customer issues at once?
This role needs flexibility for nights, weekends, and holidays. What does your availability look like?
Tell me about a time you turned a frustrated customer into a happy one.
other:
Pay, Shift, Benefits, Background, Drug Test Information, and Career Pathway:
Pay: $13.46 - $22.40/hr per the posting.
Shift: Full-time, fully remote. Must be able to work day, night, weekend, and holiday shifts. Shift flexibility is required.
Benefits: Not listed in the posting. Confirm with the recruiter.
Equipment: Not confirmed in the posting. At home employees need high-speed internet, a desk and chair, and a private, confidential workspace. The workstation must have an Ethernet (wired) connection.
Co-working: Marked No because the posting requires a confidential working space with wired internet at home. Confirm with the recruiter.
Travel: Less than 25%.
Felony Friendly?: Not stated. The posting says the role has access to highly confidential information, so expect a background check.
Drug Test: Not mentioned in the posting.
Notes: Sorenson is minority owned and a disability friendly employer (EOE, Disability/Age). This is one of the few remote roles we have that is built for Deaf participants. Tier 2 version of this role also exists and needs 2 years of customer service plus networking/OS knowledge.
Career Pathway: Videophone Customer Care Agent Tier 1 > Tier 2 > Lead/Supervisor (not confirmed in posting)
training: discussed in interview. must be flexible for day, night, weekend, and holiday shifts
